issues.description: The problem statement (UML and instructions) requires the Lecture constructor parameters to follow the attribute order: lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors. The solution implementation provides a constructor with a different parameter order (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This mismatch breaks the specified constructor signature order and can confuse students implementing the constructor to match the UML (and may cause tests that expect the UML order to fail).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter order consistent with the UML and problem instructions. Change the solution constructor signature to: Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and assign the parameters to fields accordingly. Alternatively, if a different parameter order is intended, update the problem statement/UML to reflect that order.
